description: FANOS telemetry — the canonical CoherenceFrame wire format and a known-answer vector. The load-bearing field is the 3-bit Fano/Hamming syndrome (Minimal Self-Observation Overhead theorem, docs/design-telemetry.md §1); the f32 coherence scalars are convenience. Pinned in fanos-telemetry (src/frame.rs).

layout_big_endian.note: 3-bit Fano/Hamming localizer: 0 healthy, 1..=7 faulted point address

bits[0:1] regime (0 Aggregate,1 CollectiveSubject,2 OverCoupled); bits[2:3] alarm (0 Healthy,1 Integration,2 Structure); bit[4] integrated (Phi>=1); bit[5] correlation_measured — 1 = the r these scalars were computed at was read from a full observation window, 0 = assumed from configuration because the node has none yet. ABSENT MEANS ASSUMED: a producer that does not set it must be read as unmeasured, never the reverse. An unmeasured frame still carries healthy-looking scalars (at the reference r=0.45: Phi=1.215, R=0.4514), so a reader that ignores this bit cannot tell a blind node from a healthy one, and must not average such a frame into a roll-up.

input.cell: equicorrelated PG(2,2) Fano cell, mean r = 0.5 (collective-subject window)
